question: Who proposed to pass an Act for the repair and protection of historical monuments of the country?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lord Curzon**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Lord Curzon served as the Viceroy of India from 1899 to 1905.
 
• He is renowned for his efforts in the preservation of historical monuments in India.
 
• In 1904, Lord Curzon passed the Ancient Monuments Preservation Act.
 
• This act aimed to protect and preserve ancient monuments, ensuring their maintenance and preventing their destruction.
 
• Under this act, the Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) was given the authority to manage and maintain these historical sites.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Archaeological Survey of India (ASI)**

 
 
• The ASI was established in 1861 by Alexander Cunningham.
 
• It is an attached office under the Ministry of Culture, Government of India.
 
• Its primary function is to conduct archaeological research and protect the cultural heritage of the country.
 
• The ASI manages more than 3,600 ancient monuments, archaeological sites, and remains of national importance.
 
 
 
• **Ancient Monuments Preservation Act of 1904**
 
 
• This act was one of the earliest measures taken to safeguard India's heritage.
 
• It provided the government with the power to declare ancient monuments as protected and undertake their maintenance.
 
• The act also allowed the government to acquire land surrounding these monuments to ensure their protection.
 
• It laid the foundation for future legislation aimed at heritage conservation in India.
 
 
 
• **Lord Curzon's Contributions**
 
 
• Aside from the Ancient Monuments Preservation Act, Lord Curzon also established the Victoria Memorial in Kolkata.
 
• He was instrumental in the restoration of the Taj Mahal and other significant monuments.
 
• His tenure marked a significant period in the cultural and historical preservation efforts in India.
 
• Curzon's policies emphasized the importance of maintaining and showcasing India's rich historical legacy.
